Safety goal: SG-01 Avoid unintended acceleration
Requirement: Limit commanded acceleration to the envelope for the current speed, and to zero or braking whenever the distance to a road user or obstacle ahead detected by EL-03 is below the safe longitudinal distance
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Fault injection of excessive acceleration commands in HIL; scenario tests

Safety goal: SG-01 Avoid unintended acceleration
Requirement: Detect actual acceleration above the bounded command from the vehicle state (EL-06), then cut propulsion and brake to standstill within the fault tolerant time interval
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Fault injection on the vehicle side; FTTI measurement (WP-S-04)

Safety goal: SG-01 Avoid unintended acceleration
Requirement: Cut propulsion on the safety monitor's command, whatever Autoware commands
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Supplier evidence under the DIA; vehicle test

Safety goal: SG-01 Avoid unintended acceleration
Requirement: Deliver measured speed and longitudinal acceleration to the safety monitor without passing through Autoware, and flag their own faults
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Supplier evidence under the DIA; fault injection on the signal path

Safety goal: SG-01 Avoid unintended acceleration
Requirement: Plan and command acceleration within the vehicle's comfort and legal limits
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Simulation and vehicle test

Safety goal: SG-02 Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a collision the planned trajectory avoids
Requirement: Detect road users and obstacles in and beside the vehicle's swept path out to the stopping distance at the maximum ODD speed, by day and night and in the weather of ODD-10 and ODD-11, and report their position and velocity to the monitor
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Detection performance tests across the ODD; fault injection of sensor faults

Safety goal: SG-02 Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a collision the planned trajectory avoids
Requirement: When a detected road user or obstacle is closer than the safe longitudinal distance and the commanded deceleration does not restore it, command the deceleration that does
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Scenario tests (cut-in, sudden stop, pedestrian entering); HIL

Safety goal: SG-02 Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a collision the planned trajectory avoids
Requirement: Compare achieved with commanded deceleration (EL-06) and switch to the secondary braking path on a shortfall
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Fault injection on the primary brake path

Safety goal: SG-02 Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a collision the planned trajectory avoids
Requirement: Provide a secondary braking path that can still stop the vehicle after any single fault in the primary one
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Supplier evidence under the DIA

Safety goal: SG-02 Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a collision the planned trajectory avoids
Requirement: Plan and control to keep a safe distance and stop for road users and obstacles (nominal function)
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Simulation and vehicle test

Safety goal: SG-03 Avoid unintended hard deceleration
Requirement: Keep false detections in the swept path below the rate the SOTIF acceptance criteria allow, so that monitor interventions are rarely unjustified
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Field and replay data over the ODD; false-positive rate estimation

Safety goal: SG-03 Avoid unintended hard deceleration
Requirement: Limit decelerations from Autoware above the comfortable level that EL-03 does not confirm with a road user or obstacle to a firm, non-emergency level of 3 m/s² (DQ-019 A, DQ-033 A)
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Fault injection of spurious braking commands; scenario tests

Safety goal: SG-03 Avoid unintended hard deceleration
Requirement: Apply emergency-level deceleration on the monitor's own initiative only when FSR-02.02 requires it
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Review of the intervention logic; replay tests

Safety goal: SG-04 Avoid unintended lateral motion out of the planned path
Requirement: Reject steering commands whose predicted swept path, over the stopping time, comes within the safe lateral distance of a road user, obstacle or kerb detected by EL-03, and stop in lane instead
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Fault injection of steering commands; scenario tests with oncoming traffic and cyclists

Safety goal: SG-04 Avoid unintended lateral motion out of the planned path
Requirement: Limit commanded steering angle and rate to the envelope for the current speed
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Fault injection; HIL

Safety goal: SG-04 Avoid unintended lateral motion out of the planned path
Requirement: Compare achieved with commanded steering (EL-06) and stop in lane on a deviation beyond the tolerance
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Fault injection on the steering path

Safety goal: SG-04 Avoid unintended lateral motion out of the planned path
Requirement: Keep steering controllable by wire after any single fault long enough to complete a stop in lane
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Supplier evidence under the DIA

Safety goal: SG-04 Avoid unintended lateral motion out of the planned path
Requirement: Deliver measured steering angle to the safety monitor without passing through Autoware, and flag its own faults
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Supplier evidence under the DIA; fault injection on the signal path

Safety goal: SG-04 Avoid unintended lateral motion out of the planned path
Requirement: Plan and follow a path inside the lane and the drivable area (nominal function)
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Simulation and vehicle test

Safety goal: SG-05 Avoid unintended motion from standstill, forward or backward
Requirement: At standstill, hold the service brake and park brake until all release conditions hold: doors closed (EL-08), no road user or obstacle detected by EL-03 in the near field in the direction of travel, and a motion request in the selected gear
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Fault injection; scenario tests at stops with passengers and pedestrians

Safety goal: SG-05 Avoid unintended motion from standstill, forward or backward
Requirement: Detect motion while holding (EL-06) and apply the park brake
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Fault injection on the brake hold

Safety goal: SG-05 Avoid unintended motion from standstill, forward or backward
Requirement: Allow reverse only at standstill, on request, and with the rear near field clear as detected by EL-03
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Fault injection of gear commands; scenario tests

Safety goal: SG-05 Avoid unintended motion from standstill, forward or backward
Requirement: Apply and hold the park brake on the safety monitor's command
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Supplier evidence under the DIA

Safety goal: SG-05 Avoid unintended motion from standstill, forward or backward
Requirement: Report door state to the safety monitor and inhibit motion with any door open
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Supplier evidence; vehicle test

Safety goal: SG-06 Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or crosswalk against right of way
Requirement: Do not permit motion whose swept path crosses the predicted path of a road user detected by EL-03 before the vehicle could stop or clear it, using stated bounds on other road users' acceleration and speed (DQ-017 A)
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Scenario tests at intersections, unprotected turns, roundabouts and crosswalks; formal check of the rule

Safety goal: SG-06 Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or crosswalk against right of way
Requirement: Limit speed where EL-03's view is occluded so that the vehicle can stop for a road user emerging at the assumed maximum speed (DQ-017 A)
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Scenario tests with occlusions

Safety goal: SG-06 Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or crosswalk against right of way
Requirement: Obey traffic lights, signs and right of way, treating an unknown or unrecognised signal as red (OEDR-05 to OEDR-07); argued under SOTIF (DQ-017 A)
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Simulation, scenario and vehicle tests; SOTIF evaluation (WP-V-03)

Safety goal: SG-07 Reach a minimal risk condition whenever the item can no longer drive safely
Requirement: Detect loss, delay or implausibility of Autoware's commands within the detection time WP-S-04 allots
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Fault injection (computer, network, process faults); timing measurement

Safety goal: SG-07 Reach a minimal risk condition whenever the item can no longer drive safely
Requirement: On detection, bring the vehicle to a stop in lane with hazard lights on and hold it, without Autoware
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Fault injection; vehicle test

Safety goal: SG-07 Reach a minimal risk condition whenever the item can no longer drive safely
Requirement: Keep the safety monitor, EL-03 and the actuation path powered after any single fault of the Autoware computer's supply
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Supplier evidence; power fault injection

Safety goal: SG-07 Reach a minimal risk condition whenever the item can no longer drive safely
Requirement: After a minimal risk condition, resume motion only on an explicit release from the remote operations centre with the release conditions of FSR-05.01 met
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Review; scenario test

Safety goal: SG-07 Reach a minimal risk condition whenever the item can no longer drive safely
Requirement: Carry out an MRM when its diagnostics or ODD monitors (MON-01 to MON-04) require it, pulling over when it can and stopping in lane otherwise (DQ-016 A)
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Simulation and vehicle test

Safety goal: SG-07 Reach a minimal risk condition whenever the item can no longer drive safely
Requirement: Brake to a standstill and hold it when commands from the safety monitor stop for longer than the time WP-S-04 sets, whatever Autoware sends (WP-C-12 MRM-5)
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Supplier evidence under the DIA; vehicle test with the monitor disconnected

Safety goal: SG-07 Reach a minimal risk condition whenever the item can no longer drive safely
Requirement: On detecting a fault of its own, stop sending commands to the vehicle, so that the vehicle's own stop (FSR-07.06) takes over
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Fault injection inside the monitor; review of its diagnostic coverage

Safety goal: SG-07 Reach a minimal risk condition whenever the item can no longer drive safely
Requirement: When EL-03 fails, have Autoware stop in lane comfortably, check its speed, deceleration and steering against the vehicle state (EL-06), and stop the vehicle itself if it does not slow as expected (DQ-021 A)
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Fault injection of EL-03 faults with Autoware's stop delayed or missing

Safety goal: SG-08 Do not act on remote driving commands that are stale, corrupted or not the operator's
Requirement: In REMOTE mode, reject commands older than the age bound WP-S-04 sets, out of sequence or failing their integrity check, and stop
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Fault injection of delayed, repeated and corrupted commands

Safety goal: SG-08 Do not act on remote driving commands that are stale, corrupted or not the operator's
Requirement: Apply the same envelope checks to remote commands as to Autoware's (FSR-01.01, FSR-02.02, FSR-04.01, FSR-06.01)
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Scenario tests in REMOTE mode

Safety goal: SG-08 Do not act on remote driving commands that are stale, corrupted or not the operator's
Requirement: Send every remote driving command with a time stamp, sequence number and integrity protection
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Interface test; cybersecurity verification (WP-C-10)

Safety goal: SG-09 Avoid signalling a manoeuvre other than the one performed
Requirement: Compare the commanded turn indicator with the commanded and achieved steering direction, and switch to hazard lights on a mismatch
To be verified by (WP-C-04): Fault injection of indicator commands
